# THIS FILE IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY CARGO
#
# When uploading crates to the registry Cargo will automatically
# "normalize" Cargo.toml files for maximal compatibility
# with all versions of Cargo and also rewrite `path` dependencies
# to registry (e.g., crates.io) dependencies.
#
# If you are reading this file be aware that the original Cargo.toml
# will likely look very different (and much more reasonable).
# See Cargo.toml.orig for the original contents.

[package]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88.0"
name = "gnostr-n34-relay"
version = "970629.1845.739707"
authors = ["gnostr admin@gnostr.org"]
build = "build.rs"
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "A nostr GRASP relay implementation"
homepage = "https://github.com/gnostr-org/get_file_hash"
documentation = "https://github.com/gnostr-org/get_file_hash#readme"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = [
    "nostr",
    "NIP-34",
    "GRASP",
]
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
repository = "https://github.com/gnostr-org/get_file_hash"

[package.metadata.wix]
upgrade-guid = "036A2A4F-DA54-4FE2-B2D8-8C58D5814874"
path-guid = "97D3207D-71DB-4DD0-B548-E43E8C664B7D"
license = false
eula = false
documentation = "https://relay.n34.dev/docs.html"
homepage = "https://relay.n34.dev"

[features]
gen-protos = []

[lib]
name = "gnostr_n34_relay"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "nip34_relay"
path = "src/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "simple_plugins_grpc"
path = "examples/simple_plugins_grpc.rs"

[dependencies.axum]
version = "0.8.6"
features = [
    "http2",
    "ws",
]

[dependencies.base64]
version = "0.22.1"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[dependencies.config]
version = "0.15.15"
features = ["toml"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.const_format]
version = "0.2.34"

[dependencies.convert_case]
version = "0.8.0"

[dependencies.dirs]
version = "6.0.0"

[dependencies.easy-ext]
version = "1.0.2"

[dependencies.either]
version = "1.15.0"

[dependencies.flume]
version = "0.11.1"

[dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3.31"

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.7.0"

[dependencies.hyper-util]
version = "0.1.17"

[dependencies.nostr]
version = "0.44.2"
features = [
    "std",
    "nip46",
    "nip96",
    "std",
]
default-features = false

[dependencies.nostr-database]
version = "0.44.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.nostr-lmdb]
version = "0.44.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.nostr-relay-builder]
version = "0.44.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.parking_lot]
version = "0.12.5"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.prost]
version = "0.14.1"

[dependencies.rhai]
version = "1.23.4"
features = [
    "no_position",
    "sync",
    "serde",
    "decimal",
]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"
features = ["rc"]

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"

[dependencies.serde_with]
version = "3.15.0"

[dependencies.sha1]
version = "0.10.6"

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.10.9"

[dependencies.strum]
version = "0.27.2"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.16"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.47.1"
features = [
    "macros",
    "rt-multi-thread",
    "signal",
    "fs",
    "process",
]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7.17"
features = ["io"]

[dependencies.toml]
version = "0.9.5"

[dependencies.tonic]
version = "0.14.2"
features = [
    "tls-ring",
    "tls-webpki-roots",
    "gzip",
    "deflate",
]

[dependencies.tonic-prost]
version = "0.14.2"

[dependencies.tower]
version = "0.5.2"
features = ["limit"]

[dependencies.tower-http]
version = "0.6.6"
features = [
    "cors",
    "decompression-br",
    "decompression-deflate",
    "decompression-gzip",
    "decompression-zstd",
    "trace",
    "timeout",
]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.41"

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.20"
features = ["env-filter"]

[build-dependencies.tonic-prost-build]
version = "0.14.2"

[target."cfg(not(windows))".build-dependencies.protobuf-src]
version = "2.1.0"
